description: Original curated layout recommendations; do not treat suggestions as source facts.

HISTORY_CULTURE: Chronological source-grounded timeline with dated captions and an authentic place-specific archival visual when verifiable.
Two-column editorial spread: short context left and captioned geographic visual right, preserving names and dates.
Compare documented periods with a readable table and a source note; use only relationships supported by the source.
TECH_AI: Preserve code and show a labeled process diagram beside its explanation.
Arrange documented components as a compact grid with accurate captions; do not invent connections.
Use a code block and a step-by-step narrative with sufficient contrast and line wrapping.
FINANCE_BUSINESS: Use a metric callout and clearly labeled unit, currency and time period from the source.
Use a comparison table only where the source provides comparable values.
Pair a verified chart with a short explanatory text and visible data source.
ECO_SCIENCE: Use a labeled subject-specific image beside a concise evidence-based explanation.
Present measurements with units and the source context; avoid unsupported causality.
Illustrate a documented process with a simple annotated diagram and source note.
ACADEMIC_GUIDE: Use a clear concept heading, a concise definition and a source-grounded example.
Present a documented sequence as numbered steps with a small highlighted rule.
Arrange related concepts in a readable two-column comparison without inventing material.
